name: mixed language input in Persian with English fragments
description: Tests the engine's mixed-language detection when a Persian speaker inserts English words into their Persian messages. Verifies that mixed-script input triggers the Persian mixedLanguageResponses pool, that very short English fragments below the threshold are ignored (false negative prevention), and that pure Persian resumes normal processing.

turns.text: My manager خیلی باهاش مشکل دارم
واقعاً از این وضعیت خسته شدم

expected.finalTurn: Turn 2 contains English 'My manager' mixed with Persian. _isMixedLanguage should detect foreign letters (Latin) above threshold. Response should use Persian mixedLanguageResponses pool. No topic is assigned during redirect. Turn 3 is pure Persian and routes normally to sadness topic.
expected.behavior: Mixed-language detection works symmetrically in both directions: when active language is Persian, Latin letters are 'foreign'. Short foreign fragments below MIXED_SCRIPT_FOREIGN_MIN (3 chars minimum) do not trigger false positives. No topic assigned during mixed-language redirect.
